panels.description: Total storage capacity across all volumes

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (s.TotalUsedBytes + s.TotalFreeBytes) / 1073741824.0 AS TotalGB
FROM FileSizes.dbo.BatchSummary s
WHERE s.BatchId = '${batchid}'

panels.title: Total Storage

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.TotalUsedBytes / 1073741824.0 AS UsedGB
FROM FileSizes.dbo.BatchSummary s
WHERE s.BatchId = '${batchid}'

SELECT 100.0 * s.TotalUsedBytes / NULLIF(s.TotalUsedBytes + s.TotalFreeBytes, 0) AS PctUsed
FROM FileSizes.dbo.BatchSummary s
WHERE s.BatchId = '${batchid}'

SELECT s.TotalFiles
FROM FileSizes.dbo.BatchSummary s
WHERE s.BatchId = '${batchid}'

SELECT s.StaleFilesBytes / 1073741824.0 AS StaleGB
FROM FileSizes.dbo.BatchSummary s
WHERE s.BatchId = '${batchid}'

panels.description: Wasted space from potential duplicate files (same name+size, >10MB)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.DuplicateCandidatesWastedBytes / 1073741824.0 AS DupWastedGB
FROM FileSizes.dbo.BatchSummary s
WHERE s.BatchId = '${batchid}'

panels.title: Dup Waste

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.TempCacheFilesBytes / 1073741824.0 AS TempGB
FROM FileSizes.dbo.BatchSummary s
WHERE s.BatchId = '${batchid}'

SELECT 'Server' AS Metric, b.ServerName AS Value FROM FileSizes.dbo.ScanBatch b WHERE b.BatchId = '${batchid}'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Collected', CONVERT(VARCHAR, b.CollectedAtUtc, 120) FROM FileSizes.dbo.ScanBatch b WHERE b.BatchId = '${batchid}'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Tool', b.ToolName + ' v' + ISNULL(b.ToolVersion, '?') FROM FileSizes.dbo.ScanBatch b WHERE b.BatchId = '${batchid}'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Collected By', b.CollectedBy FROM FileSizes.dbo.ScanBatch b WHERE b.BatchId = '${batchid}'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Duration', CAST(b.DurationSec AS VARCHAR) + ' sec' FROM FileSizes.dbo.ScanBatch b WHERE b.BatchId = '${batchid}'

SELECT
    v.VolumeName,
    v.VolumeLabel,
    v.TotalSizeBytes / 1073741824.0 AS TotalGB,
    v.FreeSizeBytes / 1073741824.0 AS FreeGB,
    CASE WHEN v.TotalSizeBytes > 0
         THEN 100.0 * (v.TotalSizeBytes - v.FreeSizeBytes) / v.TotalSizeBytes
         ELSE NULL
    END AS PctUsed,
    v.FileCount,
    v.DirectoryCount
FROM FileSizes.dbo.ScanVolume v
WHERE v.BatchId = '${batchid}'
ORDER BY v.VolumeName

SELECT TOP 20
    CASE
        WHEN CHARINDEX('\', f.FullPath, LEN(f.Volume) + 2) > 0
        THEN SUBSTRING(f.FullPath, LEN(f.Volume) + 2,
                       CHARINDEX('\', f.FullPath, LEN(f.Volume) + 2) - LEN(f.Volume) - 2)
        ELSE '(root files)'
    END AS Folder,
    SUM(f.FileSize) / 1073741824.0 AS TotalGB
FROM FileSizes.dbo.FileEntry f
WHERE f.BatchId = '${batchid}'
  AND f.IsDirectory = 0
  AND f.FileSize IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    CASE
        WHEN CHARINDEX('\', f.FullPath, LEN(f.Volume) + 2) > 0
        THEN SUBSTRING(f.FullPath, LEN(f.Volume) + 2,
                       CHARINDEX('\', f.FullPath, LEN(f.Volume) + 2) - LEN(f.Volume) - 2)
        ELSE '(root files)'
    END
ORDER BY TotalGB DESC

SELECT TOP 10
    CASE
        WHEN CHARINDEX('.', REVERSE(f.FileName)) > 0
        THEN UPPER(RIGHT(f.FileName, CHARINDEX('.', REVERSE(f.FileName)) - 1))
        ELSE '(no ext)'
    END AS Extension,
    SUM(f.FileSize) / 1073741824.0 AS TotalGB
FROM FileSizes.dbo.FileEntry f
WHERE f.BatchId = '${batchid}'
  AND f.IsDirectory = 0
  AND f.FileSize IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    CASE
        WHEN CHARINDEX('.', REVERSE(f.FileName)) > 0
        THEN UPPER(RIGHT(f.FileName, CHARINDEX('.', REVERSE(f.FileName)) - 1))
        ELSE '(no ext)'
    END
ORDER BY TotalGB DESC

SELECT
    AgeCategory,
    TotalGB
FROM (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN f.ModifiedTime >= DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETUTCDATE()) THEN '< 1 month'
            WHEN f.ModifiedTime >= DATEADD(MONTH, -6, GETUTCDATE()) THEN '1-6 months'
            WHEN f.ModifiedTime >= DATEADD(YEAR, -1, GETUTCDATE()) THEN '6-12 months'
            WHEN f.ModifiedTime >= DATEADD(YEAR, -2, GETUTCDATE()) THEN '1-2 years'
            WHEN f.ModifiedTime >= DATEADD(YEAR, -5, GETUTCDATE()) THEN '2-5 years'
            ELSE '> 5 years'
        END AS AgeCategory,
        CASE
            WHEN f.ModifiedTime >= DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETUTCDATE()) THEN 1
            WHEN f.ModifiedTime >= DATEADD(MONTH, -6, GETUTCDATE()) THEN 2
            WHEN f.ModifiedTime >= DATEADD(YEAR, -1, GETUTCDATE()) THEN 3
            WHEN f.ModifiedTime >= DATEADD(YEAR, -2, GETUTCDATE()) THEN 4
            WHEN f.ModifiedTime >= DATEADD(YEAR, -5, GETUTCDATE()) THEN 5
            ELSE 6
        END AS SortOrder,
        SUM(f.FileSize) / 1073741824.0 AS TotalGB
    FROM FileSizes.dbo.FileEntry f
    WHERE f.BatchId = '${batchid}'
      AND f.IsDirectory = 0
      AND f.ModifiedTime IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        CASE
            WHEN f.ModifiedTime >= DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETUTCDATE()) THEN '< 1 month'
            WHEN f.ModifiedTime >= DATEADD(MONTH, -6, GETUTCDATE()) THEN '1-6 months'
            WHEN f.ModifiedTime >= DATEADD(YEAR, -1, GETUTCDATE()) THEN '6-12 months'
            WHEN f.ModifiedTime >= DATEADD(YEAR, -2, GETUTCDATE()) THEN '1-2 years'
            WHEN f.ModifiedTime >= DATEADD(YEAR, -5, GETUTCDATE()) THEN '2-5 years'
            ELSE '> 5 years'
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN f.ModifiedTime >= DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETUTCDATE()) THEN 1
            WHEN f.ModifiedTime >= DATEADD(MONTH, -6, GETUTCDATE()) THEN 2
            WHEN f.ModifiedTime >= DATEADD(YEAR, -1, GETUTCDATE()) THEN 3
            WHEN f.ModifiedTime >= DATEADD(YEAR, -2, GETUTCDATE()) THEN 4
            WHEN f.ModifiedTime >= DATEADD(YEAR, -5, GETUTCDATE()) THEN 5
            ELSE 6
        END
) t
ORDER BY SortOrder

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN CHARINDEX('.', REVERSE(f.FileName)) > 0
        THEN LOWER(RIGHT(f.FileName, CHARINDEX('.', REVERSE(f.FileName)) - 1))
        ELSE '(no ext)'
    END AS Extension,
    COUNT(*) AS FileCount,
    SUM(f.FileSize) / 1073741824.0 AS TotalGB,
    AVG(f.FileSize) / 1048576.0 AS AvgSizeMB,
    MAX(f.FileSize) / 1073741824.0 AS LargestGB
FROM FileSizes.dbo.FileEntry f
WHERE f.BatchId = '${batchid}'
  AND f.IsDirectory = 0
  AND f.FileSize IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    CASE
        WHEN CHARINDEX('.', REVERSE(f.FileName)) > 0
        THEN LOWER(RIGHT(f.FileName, CHARINDEX('.', REVERSE(f.FileName)) - 1))
        ELSE '(no ext)'
    END
ORDER BY TotalGB DESC

panels.title: File Type Distribution (click extension to drill down)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 50
    CASE
        WHEN CHARINDEX('\', f.FullPath, LEN(f.Volume) + 2) > 0
        THEN SUBSTRING(f.FullPath, LEN(f.Volume) + 2,
                       CHARINDEX('\', f.FullPath, LEN(f.Volume) + 2) - LEN(f.Volume) - 2)
        ELSE '(root files)'
    END AS TopFolder,
    COUNT(*) AS FileCount,
    SUM(f.FileSize) / 1073741824.0 AS TotalGB
FROM FileSizes.dbo.FileEntry f
WHERE f.BatchId = '${batchid}'
  AND f.IsDirectory = 0
  AND f.FileSize IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    CASE
        WHEN CHARINDEX('\', f.FullPath, LEN(f.Volume) + 2) > 0
        THEN SUBSTRING(f.FullPath, LEN(f.Volume) + 2,
                       CHARINDEX('\', f.FullPath, LEN(f.Volume) + 2) - LEN(f.Volume) - 2)
        ELSE '(root files)'
    END
ORDER BY TotalGB DESC

SELECT TOP 100
    f.Volume,
    f.FullPath,
    f.FileSize / 1048576.0 AS SizeMB,
    f.ModifiedTime,
    DATEDIFF(DAY, f.ModifiedTime, SYSUTCDATETIME()) AS DaysSinceModified
FROM FileSizes.dbo.FileEntry f
WHERE f.BatchId = '${batchid}'
  AND f.IsDirectory = 0
  AND f.FileSize >= 104857600
  AND f.ModifiedTime < DATEADD(YEAR, -2, SYSUTCDATETIME())
ORDER BY f.FileSize DESC

panels.title: Stale Files (>100MB, not modified in 2+ years)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    f.FileName,
    f.FileSize / 1048576.0 AS SizeMB,
    COUNT(*) AS CopyCount,
    (COUNT(*) - 1) * f.FileSize / 1073741824.0 AS WastedGB
FROM FileSizes.dbo.FileEntry f
WHERE f.BatchId = '${batchid}'
  AND f.IsDirectory = 0
  AND f.FileSize >= 10485760
GROUP BY f.FileName, f.FileSize
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY WastedGB DESC

SELECT TOP 100
    f.FullPath,
    f.FileName,
    f.FileSize / 1048576.0 AS SizeMB,
    f.ModifiedTime
FROM FileSizes.dbo.FileEntry f
WHERE f.BatchId = '${batchid}'
  AND f.IsDirectory = 0
  AND f.IsTempCache = 1
ORDER BY f.FileSize DESC

SELECT TOP 50
    f.Volume,
    f.FullPath,
    f.FileSize / 1073741824.0 AS SizeGB,
    f.ModifiedTime,
    f.AccessedTime
FROM FileSizes.dbo.FileEntry f
WHERE f.BatchId = '${batchid}'
  AND f.IsDirectory = 0
ORDER BY f.FileSize DESC

panels.description: Files with the selected extension. Clear the extension variable to hide this panel.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 200
    f.FullPath,
    f.FileName,
    f.FileSize / 1048576.0 AS SizeMB,
    f.ModifiedTime
FROM FileSizes.dbo.FileEntry f
WHERE f.BatchId = '${batchid}'
  AND f.IsDirectory = 0
  AND '${extension}' <> ''
  AND LOWER(RIGHT(f.FileName, LEN('${extension}') + 1)) = LOWER('.${extension}')
ORDER BY f.FileSize DESC

panels.title: Files with .${extension} extension

panels.description: Files within the selected folder. Clear the folder variable to hide this panel.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 200
    f.FullPath,
    f.FileName,
    f.FileSize / 1048576.0 AS SizeMB,
    f.ModifiedTime
FROM FileSizes.dbo.FileEntry f
WHERE f.BatchId = '${batchid}'
  AND f.IsDirectory = 0
  AND '${folder}' <> ''
  AND f.FullPath LIKE '%\${folder}\%'
ORDER BY f.FileSize DESC
